entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram lowering produced %s sample kind (%T), want histogram
entries.rationale: lowerHistogramQuantile calls this helper only after its argument is admitted as histogram-valued, and the helper lowers that same argument through lowerExpHistogramValuedShape. Every successful matched branch publishes SampleKindHistogram, making any other kind an internal recognizer/lowerer disagreement.
